csv_project_name: Design for Rampart Street Park Design
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Orange ( City ), a Municipal Corporation, is requesting proposals from qualified professional design firms, for design services and corresponding preparation of construction plans, specifications, cost estimates, bidding and construction support for the Rampart Street Park Design Project. The City intends to develop a new passive park on the site with amenities, to potentially include walking path(s), an enclosed dog amenity, bench seating, native landscaping, drinking fountain/bottle filler/dog watering station, trash receptacle(s), fencing, and signage. The design should consider and incorporate, where possible, the existing trees and minimize disruption to existing root zones. The design should include the use of durable, low maintenance materials and landscaping.
